title: KPIReadings
description: What one KPI actually read, period by period. Its own file beside the KPI rather than a list inside it, because the two have different lifetimes: a definition is written once and rarely changes, and a reading arrives every cycle forever. Keeping them together would make every quarterly number a new version of the definition, and every diff would read as though the definition had changed when only the world had. Scoped to one KPI the way a StakeholderMap is scoped to one piece of work. See TAXONOMY.md D8.

kpi.description: The KPI these are readings of. What is measured, in what unit, which way is good and how often is read from there and never restated here: a reading that disagreed with its own definition about the unit would be unanswerable.

readings.description: One entry per period that has been read. Which periods exist is derived from the KPI's ReportingCycle, so a period with no entry is simply one nobody has read yet, which is a state worth seeing rather than a zero. Kept, besides, as one record per reading, keyed by period, so recording one costs the same however long the series is and a period can be read as it stood at any time (docs/adr/0013).

period.description: The period this reading is for, as the month it ends. One reading per period (a kind rule): two numbers for the same period is a disagreement, not data.

value.description: The number, in the unit the KPI names. No unit here: one place to change it.

provisional.description: Whether this number may still be restated. A mark rather than the word "provisional" written into the note, so a chart can show it and a roll-up can decide whether to count it.

note.description: Why this number is what it is, when it needs saying: a strike, a change of method, a period nobody could collect.
